raw_segments.text: Perdita, now Jove afford you cause.
To me the difference forges dread.
Your greatness hath not been us to fear.
Even now I tremble to think your father, by some accident, should pass this way, as you
How would he look to see his work, so noble, vially bound up?
Or how should I in these my borrowed flaunts behold the sternness of his presence?
